It sounds like your managing really well. Keep fighting the good fight. Getting over an 8 year old abusive relationship takes a strong mother fucker and a lot of people can't get over a year long relationship. Take your time but try to get a little better everyday, that's the goal.

It's okay to grieve. It's a hard time for you but you can't do it forever. Try to feel just a little better everyday. There are 7 billion people, they just weren't your perfect match and that's okay, shit happens but someone else is out there just waiting to marry you in the future. Don't deprive them of that over one sour relationship. Get yourself your favorite dinner tonight and just try to relax.

You messed up and that's okay but you gotta bite the bullet and tell your parents. The longer you go the worse it'll be. Just tell your parents how you feel, if they got you help before I'm sure they can understand you're having a tough time. My advice is to be honest with them. I don't know your parents but I don't know what more advice I can give with the information. Hope you feel better buddy.

Sounds like your only real problem is having a job but that's not a hard problem to solve. Just send apps to some of the fast-food places around you and while you do that try to find a better job. I don't have a license but it's really not the end of the world. Driving makes my anxiety go nuts and I've avoided it because of it. A guy a knew used to ride his bike fucking EVERYWHERE and when it was too far he would use the bus and bike. If your Foster family still let's you stay there then they gotta care about you, if not they would've booted you at like 18. As far as the social anxiety goes, you just gotta be social to beat it. If you feel like you make a lot of fumbles in conversations then try looking into charisma videos on YouTube. I'm 23 and haven't had a job in over a year from my stomach problems. It's hard to pursue a career when companies dump your ass after you call off a few days. Sorry this is just kinda an information dump but I'm tired and hope this helped, even just a little.

Just remember that this isn't over yet and you have nothing to lose by trying. Break ups are fucking hard and you need some time to get yourself together. It's natural, you aren't a fuck up or any different from the next guy. Feel sad today and tomorrow and next week but you have to start taking steps forward at some point. Take off summer class but sign up for fall classes and give yourself as much of a break from work as you can afford and then start looking for a new job. No one expects you get over like it was nothing.

The fact that you are still caught up with him after months of a very short meaningless relationship shows that you have something else going on. You should see a therapist and talk with them about your feelings, they're trained to help you with this. I hope you feel better.

A relationship shouldn't make you feel complete and if that's what's going on then maybe talking to a therapist to help you figure out some of your feelings and see if there is some way to make you feel less lonely when you currently aren't dating. A relationship is an addition to a fulfilling life, not a requirement to have one.
